newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Rosenbauer wins 700 mln ATS Thai order.
newsitem.headline: Rosenbauer wins 700 mln ATS Thai order.

text.p: Austria's Rosenbauer International AG, a leading manufacturer of fire engines, said on Monday it had won a 700 million schilling order from the Thai government for 172 specialist vehicles.
The order, for fire engines, rescue trucks and compressor vehicles, will be delivered in two tranches in November 1997 and October 1998.
"This is Rosenbauer's biggest order for 13 years...and should have a positive impact on profit and sales in 1997 and 1998," Rosenbauer said in a statement.
